messages:
Aisha (Vendor Ops): Vendor 'CapeNode Pty Ltd' (ZA) submitted invoice INV-ZA-77 for PLN modelling service and charged 15% VAT. Bill-to is Redwood Inference LLC (US). They included VAT reg ZA987654321 and asked if Redwood can confirm exemption/zero-rate for exported services.

Ben (Tax APAC): South African VAT can be zero-rated for exported services but vendor must satisfy local rules: recipient must be a non-resident, services consumed outside SA, and the tax invoice should state "exported services - zero rated" with supplier VAT number.

Renee (AP): We need their tax invoice with clear VAT line, their VAT reg, and a written confirmation that services are consumed by a US entity. If they insist on charging VAT we can pay and later consider reclaim, but reclaim in ZA is painful.

Aisha (Vendor Ops): Drafting snip to vendor, LMK edits: ```
Hi CapeNode team,

Thanks for the invoice. To process payment we need:
1) A VAT invoice showing ZA987654321 and the VAT line clearly marked (15% or 0%).
2) If you believe the supply is zero-rated, please re-issue the invoice stating "exported services - zero rated" and the legal basis.
3) Please confirm in writing that the services are provided to Redwood Inference LLC (US) and consumed outside South Africa.
4) Attach any supporting registration screenshots from SARS if available.

If you cannot re-issue with zero-rating we will process the invoice as charged which may delay payment while we review.

Thanks,
Aisha (Vendor Ops)
```

Tom (Finance): Add: 'Please include the exact legal name that matches your SARS registration so AP can match bank details.'

Ben (Tax APAC): Also add: 'If you provide proof of export status we will accept reissued zero-rated invoice; otherwise we accept VAT this time to avoid delay.'

Aisha (Vendor Ops): Sent. Vendor replied: "We are registered and normally zero-rate exports but our billing team defaulted VAT on this invoice. We'll re-issue a zero-rated invoice and attach SARS screenshot."

Renee (AP): Great. Once re-issued please upload to vendor record and I'll process payment in USD. If they don't reissue in 3 business days we'll proceed with current invoice and flag for tax counsel.

Tom (Finance): Nice and quick. Action: update EU/APAC onboarding checklist to ask for export certification where applicable. Closing thread after invoice replaced. :white_check_mark:
